description: Test suite for card-related API endpoints in the focalboard server, including creation, retrieval, updating, and authorization checks.

methods.name: TestCreateCard
methods.description: Tests creating a card with various scenarios including unauthorized access, valid creation, and invalid data.

methods.name: TestGetCards
methods.description: Tests retrieving multiple cards with and without pagination, including authorization checks.

methods.name: TestPatchCard
methods.description: Tests updating a card, including authorization, valid updates, and invalid data handling.

methods.name: TestGetCard
methods.description: Tests fetching a single card by ID, including authorization and successful retrieval.
